name: Yūbetsu (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yūbetsu town emblem in blue and green: a blue angular frame like a stylised character enclosing a green five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Yūbetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 October 2009.

features.role: Yūbetsu town emblem — a blue angular frame like a stylised character enclosing a green five-pointed star
